name: Ebes (Hungary)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of white and blue, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Ebes (a blue and white shield with a horse and ears of grain, within a green wreath) below the name EBES in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
